svg.text: Same GPU, 18.6× the work: one request vs 24 at once
Each passport waits for the one before
What the GPU is doing, drawn to scale
vLLM batches them on the same GPU
What the GPU is doing, drawn to scale
Idle seats are what you pay for.

Measured on this lab, 3 Nov 2026: Qwen3.5-9B FP8 with thinking on, one L40S, the public app path. 1 at a time: 8 of 8 succeeded. 24 at once: 220 succeeded and 8 hit the token cap while reasoning. Nothing waited in the queue in either run.
